articles.title: Russian attacks kill 5 and wound more than 30 in Ukraine's Dnipro
articles.summary: Russian drone and missile strikes recently targeted the Ukrainian city of Dnipro, causing at least five fatalities and injuring 34, according to local authorities. These assaults highlight the severe human cost and persistent threat civilians face amidst the ongoing conflict. Such events are crucial for understanding the complex international security environment.

articles.title: Germany to despatch minesweeper for possible Hormuz mission
articles.summary: Germany intends to deploy a minesweeper to the Mediterranean, potentially for a mission in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. This action, discussed in the context of a potential US-Iran conflict, underscores international efforts to maintain maritime security and freedom of navigation. For SSB aspirants, it highlights global readiness to project force and secure critical choke points.

articles.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian apartment block kills seven, injures dozens
articles.summary: Russia launched a major overnight attack on Dnipro, Ukraine, using 619 drones and 47 missiles. The assault tragically killed seven people and injured dozens, highlighting the ongoing conflict's devastating human cost and intense aerial warfare. Ukraine's air force reported the extensive use of these aerial weapons in the coordinated attack.

articles.title: Germany to dispatch minesweeper for possible Hormuz mission
articles.summary: Germany plans to deploy a minesweeper to the Mediterranean, earmarking it for a potential mission in the critical Strait of Hormuz. This initiative, announced amid lingering US-Iran tensions, underscores Germany's commitment to maritime security and maintaining free navigation in strategically vital international waters. The deployment highlights the global efforts required to ensure stability and secure trade routes in contested regions.

articles.title: Gunfire in Mali as army battles 'terrorist groups'
articles.summary: Mali's junta-led army is battling "terrorist groups" after widespread attacks were launched across the West African nation. Witnesses reported intense fighting, escalating the more than decade-long jihadist conflict plaguing the country. This highlights the persistent security challenges and regional instability driven by extremist groups, a critical international affairs issue.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill six across Ukraine
articles.summary: Russian forces launched widespread overnight strikes across Ukraine, including a particularly deadly attack on a building in Dnipro. These latest assaults resulted in at least six fatalities. The continuous targeting of Ukrainian cities highlights the ongoing escalation and humanitarian impact of the conflict, demanding international attention and strategic analysis for its regional implications.

articles.title: Kerala elections 2026: Who after Pinarayi Vijayan? All eyes will be on these five if the Left gets it right
articles.summary: Pinarayi Vijayan, Kerala's Chief Minister since May 2016, has achieved a unique milestone in the state's political history. The 80-year-old leader is the only Chief Minister in Kerala to successfully win re-election after completing a full five-year term. This unprecedented electoral success highlights his strong political influence and the mandate received from the electorate for continued governance.

articles.title: US envoys head to Pakistan for Iran war talks
articles.summary: The EU stresses the vital importance of opening the Strait of Hormuz. Talks are stalled as Iran refuses participation due to a perceived US naval blockade. This situation underscores significant international tensions and strategic challenges surrounding a crucial global oil shipping lane, impacting maritime security and regional stability.
